description: This source file implements a plugin radio factory loader using dynamic library loading (dlopen/dlsym). It defines wrappers for radio sessions and factories, loads shared libraries, and creates radio factory instances.

classes.name: dynamic_library_deleter
classes.description: A functor to close a dynamic library handle when destroyed.

classes.name: radio_dynamic_wrapper
classes.description: Wraps a radio_session with a dynamic library handle, managing its lifetime.

classes.name: radio_factory_dynamic_wrapper
classes.description: Wraps a radio_factory with a dynamic library handle, managing its lifetime.

methods.name: create_plugin_radio_factory
methods.description: Loads a shared library for a given driver name, retrieves a factory creation function, and returns a wrapped radio_factory instance.
